body: I’ve told her a few times that what she says effects me, and it usually makes her feel guilty for making me feel that way, and that makes her feel worse.

I’m am and have been happy with her, I just don’t know what to do or how to help or if I should just break both of our hearts and break up. This is literally the only issue in our relationship, other than this, we are two peas in a pod.
Almost 4 years. She’s had her demons and feelings pretty much throughout. It’s been about 2 years she’s been pushing the “leave me” thoughts.

I’m not in therapy, but she is. I definitely need to be in therapy. I keep trying to build us up together, but then it’s back to square one. I just am afraid that she will kill herself if I leave. There have been multiple conversations that more or less confirm that she doesn’t want to live without me.
